researchNotes: versace.com returned HTTP 403 to every fetch, so the official site could not be read. The range comes from the Escentual (retailer) Shopify product feed, read in three pages; the feed was truncated in places, so coverage is partial. Gift sets, travel sprays, body care and deodorants were skipped. Concentration is taken from each product title on the retailer. Notes were read only for Eros Eau de Parfum (LookFantastic product page, type retailer, so noteSource is reported); the other entries have no notes because their retailer pages were truncated and the search snippets conflicted. Release years, perfumers and families are not stated on the pages read. Brand country not stated. Round 2: versace.com returned 403 to direct fetch; notes from Nordstrom and Ulta product pages.
